name: printable-calendar
description: Printable calendars with your country's holidays, your birthdays and events, ready as a print-quality PDF.

interface.longDescription:
Make a printable calendar as a print-ready vector PDF without leaving the chat. Ask for a 2027 calendar on one page, a 12-month wall calendar, a monthly calendar template, or a school year calendar from August to June, and get a PDF sized for Letter, A4, A3 or Tabloid paper.

Public holidays are marked for more than 200 countries and their states and regions, from open holiday data, including observed weekdays when a holiday falls on a weekend (for example the UK substitute bank holidays or a US federal holiday observed on Friday). Public holidays only by default; observances such as Mother's Day can be added.

Add birthdays and events and they are drawn in the day cells: MM-DD repeats every year, YYYY-MM-DD marks one date. Choose Monday or Sunday as the first day of the week, print ISO week numbers, add a ruled notes area under each month, pick one accent colour, and print month and weekday names in English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch or Japanese.

Layouts:
- Year at a glance: all 12 months on one page with a list of holidays and events
- Wall calendar: a cover plus one month per page, starting in any month
- Single month: one big month grid
- Month range: one page per month for up to 24 months, such as a school year

The preview in the chat shows every month with holiday and event marks, a legend for the selected month, quick toggles for week start, holidays and week numbers, and a button to download the PDF. You can also list a country's public holidays for any year from 1950 to 2200.

Limitations: holiday data covers public holidays and selected observances, not school terms; lunar, Hijri and Hebrew calendars are not drawn; Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji characters in titles or events are left out of the PDF (a note says so); up to 60 custom events and 24 months per calendar.
defaultPrompt: Make a printable 2027 calendar for Texas with US holidays and Mom's birthday on March 4
Make a 12-month wall calendar for 2027 in Polish with Polish holidays, A4, weeks starting Monday
School year calendar from August 2026 to June 2027 for California with week numbers and notes

positive.description: Year-at-a-glance calendar with state holidays and a birthday
positive.prompt: Make a printable 2027 calendar for Texas with US holidays and Mom's birthday on March 4
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar with layout=year, year=2027, country=US, subdivision=TX and events [{date: 03-04, title: Mom's birthday}]. The result is a 1-page Letter landscape PDF with weeks starting Sunday and 17 public holiday dates for Texas, United States marked, including Fri Jan 1 New Year's Day, Thu Nov 25 Thanksgiving Day and Fri Jun 18 Juneteenth (observed). Mom's birthday falls on Thu Mar 4. The widget shows all 12 months with holiday marks and a Download PDF button.

positive.description: Wall calendar in Polish with Polish holidays
positive.prompt: Make a 12-month wall calendar for 2027 in Polish with Polish holidays, A4, weeks starting Monday
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar with layout=wall, year=2027, country=PL, language=pl, paper=a4, week_start=monday. The PDF has 13 pages (a cover plus 12 months) in A4 landscape with Polish month names (Styczeń to Grudzień) and 14 public holiday dates for Poland, including Sun Mar 28 Niedziela Wielkanocna, Mon Mar 29 Drugi dzień Wielkanocy, Thu May 27 Dzień Bożego Ciała and Fri Dec 24 Wigilia Bożego Narodzenia.

positive.description: School year range with week numbers and notes
positive.prompt: Make a school year calendar from August 2026 to June 2027 for California with week numbers and a notes area
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar with layout=range, start=2026-08, end=2027-06, country=US, subdivision=CA, week_numbers=true, notes=true. The PDF has 11 pages (August 2026 to June 2027), one month per page with ISO week numbers and a ruled notes area. 12 public holiday dates for California, United States are marked, including Mon Sep 7 Labor Day, Thu Nov 26 Thanksgiving Day and Wed Mar 31 César Chávez Day.

positive.description: Single month in Japanese with Japanese holidays
positive.prompt: Make a printable May 2027 monthly calendar for Japan with month and day names in Japanese
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar with layout=month, month=2027-05, country=JP, language=ja. The PDF is 1 page, A4 landscape, weeks starting Sunday, with the heading 5月 2027 and Japanese weekday names. 3 public holiday dates are marked: Mon May 3 憲法記念日, Tue May 4 みどりの日 and Wed May 5 こどもの日.

positive.description: List bank holidays with substitute days
positive.prompt: List the 2027 bank holidays in England
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_holidays with country=GB (or England), year=2027. Returns 10 dates for England, United Kingdom, 8 of them on weekdays, including 2027-03-26 Good Friday, 2027-08-30 Summer bank holiday, and the substitute days 2027-12-27 Christmas Day (substitute day) and 2027-12-28 Boxing Day (substitute day) because Christmas falls on a Saturday.

negative.description: Adding an event to an online calendar
negative.prompt: Add my dentist appointment next Tuesday at 3pm to my Google Calendar
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call generate_calendar or find_holidays: the plugin makes printable PDF calendars and does not add events to Google, Outlook or Apple calendars.

negative.prompt: How many working days are there between March 3 and April 18, 2027?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call generate_calendar or find_holidays: counting business days between dates is not what this plugin does.

negative.prompt: What is today's date in the Hijri calendar?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call generate_calendar or find_holidays: the plugin draws Gregorian calendars and does not convert to Hijri, Hebrew or lunar dates.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: year-at-a-glance, 12-month wall, single month and month-range calendars as vector PDFs (Letter, A4, A3, Tabloid), public holidays for 200+ countries and their regions, yearly birthdays and one-off events, Monday or Sunday weeks, ISO week numbers, notes lines, accent colour, 9 languages, and a holiday list tool.

pl-PL.subtitle: Kalendarze PDF do druku
pl-PL.description: Twórz kalendarze do druku jako wektorowe pliki PDF: cały rok na jednej stronie, kalendarz ścienny na 12 miesięcy, pojedynczy miesiąc albo rok szkolny od sierpnia do czerwca. Święta państwowe dla ponad 200 krajów i ich regionów, urodziny i wydarzenia w kratkach dni, tydzień od poniedziałku lub niedzieli, numery tygodni ISO, miejsce na notatki, jeden kolor akcentu i nazwy miesięcy po polsku, angielsku, niemiecku, hiszpańsku, francusku, włosku, portugalsku, niderlandzku lub japońsku. Formaty Letter, A4, A3 i Tabloid.

de-DE.subtitle: Kalender als Druck-PDF
de-DE.description: Erstelle druckfertige Kalender als Vektor-PDF: Jahresübersicht auf einer Seite, 12-Monats-Wandkalender, ein einzelner Monat oder ein Schuljahr von August bis Juni. Gesetzliche Feiertage für über 200 Länder und ihre Bundesländer und Regionen, Geburtstage und Termine in den Tageskästchen, Wochenbeginn Montag oder Sonntag, ISO-Kalenderwochen, Notizzeilen, eine Akzentfarbe und Monatsnamen auf Deutsch, Englisch, Polnisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Portugiesisch, Niederländisch oder Japanisch. Formate Letter, A4, A3 und Tabloid.

es-ES.subtitle: Calendarios PDF para imprimir
es-ES.description: Crea calendarios para imprimir en PDF vectorial: el año completo en una página, un calendario de pared de 12 meses, un solo mes o un curso escolar de agosto a junio. Festivos oficiales de más de 200 países y sus regiones, cumpleaños y eventos en las casillas, semana desde el lunes o el domingo, números de semana ISO, espacio para notas, un color de acento y nombres de meses en español, inglés, polaco, alemán, francés, italiano, portugués, neerlandés o japonés. Tamaños Carta, A4, A3 y Tabloide.

fr-FR.subtitle: Calendriers PDF à imprimer
fr-FR.description: Créez des calendriers à imprimer en PDF vectoriel : l'année sur une page, un calendrier mural de 12 mois, un seul mois ou une année scolaire d'août à juin. Jours fériés de plus de 200 pays et de leurs régions, anniversaires et événements dans les cases, semaine commençant le lundi ou le dimanche, numéros de semaine ISO, zone de notes, une couleur d'accent et noms des mois en français, anglais, polonais, allemand, espagnol, italien, portugais, néerlandais ou japonais. Formats Letter, A4, A3 et Tabloïd.

ja-JP.subtitle: 印刷用カレンダーPDF
ja-JP.description: 印刷用カレンダーをベクターPDFで作成します。1年を1ページにまとめた年間カレンダー、表紙付き12か月の壁掛けカレンダー、1か月カレンダー、8月から6月までの学年カレンダーなどに対応。200以上の国と地域の祝日、誕生日や予定の書き込み、月曜始まり・日曜始まり、ISO週番号、メモ欄、アクセントカラー、日本語・英語など9言語の月名と曜日に対応します。用紙はレター、A4、A3、タブロイド。

pt-BR.subtitle: Calendários PDF para imprimir
pt-BR.description: Crie calendários para imprimir em PDF vetorial: o ano inteiro em uma página, calendário de parede de 12 meses, um único mês ou um ano letivo de agosto a junho. Feriados nacionais de mais de 200 países e seus estados e regiões, aniversários e eventos nas casas dos dias, semana começando na segunda ou no domingo, números de semana ISO, área de anotações, uma cor de destaque e nomes dos meses em português, inglês, polonês, alemão, espanhol, francês, italiano, holandês ou japonês. Tamanhos Carta, A4, A3 e Tabloide.
